svg.title: Corrected repair04 sample006 final-output comparison
svg.desc: Actual complete final baseline and candidate outputs. Expanded strict and relaxed DRC each improve from one error to zero. All ten vias retain exactly the same owners, positions, layer spans, copper diameters and drill diameters. Overview windows cover sixteen by sixteen millimeters; enlarged details show the left trace taking a path below the pad row. Only one final trace changes. The normal joint stage resolves the remaining issue after the trace-only pass; advanced repair skips the clean input. This is a one-board example, not a dataset performance claim.
